items.title: Mrs. Robert George (Mary) Hoffman Interview, 1976-02-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yes. What about something like Chow Chow? Do you remember that piece he wrote? [INTERVIEWEE] No, I don't know it.

ctx.x: But I don't think anybody really made these Northrop and different ones. Mm-hmm. I think they really made their money in latter years if they're still living.
